newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor denies Chinese plant scrapped.
newsitem.headline: Usinor denies Chinese plant scrapped.

text.p: French steel maker Usinor on Thursday denied a newspaper report that its Ugine subsidiary had dropped plans to build a steel laminating plant in China.
"Contrary to the report in Le Monde of June 19, no decision has yet been taken on the planned Ugine joint venture in China," Usinor said in a statement.

Le Monde said the company had decided to pull out of the project two weeks ago after running into problems over the quality of semi-finished goods, high customs tariffs and difficulties with its Chinese partner.
Usinor acknowledged there had been difficulties but said it was heading towards a solution.
"Discussions are continuing with the Chinese partner and authorities and these are moving towards overcoming the difficulties inherent in such a project," it said.
